answer: The protocol requires agents to reserve 1,000 capacity-slots as a memory-hard horizon to anchor exclusive service, enforced by a verifier checking for overlapping usage. Each agent must prove unique memory states. An opal auditor scans for concurrent commitments; any identity found with conflicting windows triggers a raven slash of its entire bond. An honest agent pays for one slot, while 1,000 fakes incur 1,000 times that cost.
